prompt:
Sub-agents are invisible in the sidebar chat. When the agent fans a task out with Claude Code's Task tool (named Agent in newer versions), say one sub-agent per PyPI page, the steps card shows the two steps "Read requests on PyPI" and "Read httpx on PyPI" and then nothing until the final answer. The tabs the sub-agents open and the pages they navigate never show up, the "Using Firefox in <site>" line doesn't move, and each step ends blank even though its sub-agent replied "requests 2.32.3".

What the panel needs from the host:

- A sub-agent's tool calls reported like the agent's own (the same tool_start and tool_end events), with one extra field on tool_start: `parent`, the toolUseId of the Task/Agent step that sub-agent is running under. Several sub-agents run at the same time. What a sub-agent says should still stay out of the chat; only the top-level agent's text belongs there.
- The Task/Agent step's tool_end `summary` should be the sub-agent's reply, cut to 300 characters at most. Claude Code appends a last text block to that result that starts with `agentId:` and holds a `<usage>` block; that isn't part of the reply. A failed sub-agent should still show as failed, with its error.
- The same reply on the step when I reopen the chat from history.

The existing tests should keep passing.

checks.name: existing_tests_pass
checks.cmd: env -u CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR -u CODEX_HOME node --test host/test/format.test.mjs host/test/host.test.mjs host/test/chat-existing.test.mjs
